title: SPA/65/2015 of Rakesh Kumar Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINTAL
SPECIAL APPEAL NO. 65 OF 2015
Rakesh Kumar ........Appellant.
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and another ......Respondent
Mr. Siddharth Singh, Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. P.C. Bisht, Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand / respondents.
Mr. Birendra Singh Adhikari, Advocate for the caveator.
Dated: 26.02.2015
Coram: Hon'ble K.M. Joseph, C.J.
 Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
K.M. Joseph, C.J. (Oral)
 Learned counsel for the appellant / petitioner seeks
permission to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to file a fresh
writ petition after disposal of the forest case and the civil suit.
2. We have also heard Mr. P.C. Bisht, learned Standing
Counsel for the State / respondents and Mr. B.S. Adhikari, learned
counsel for the caveator.
3. We are of the view that the request has to be granted.
Accordingly, the writ petition will stand dismissed as withdrawn
with liberty to file a fresh writ petition. Consequently, the
impugned judgment will stand set aside.
4. Accordingly, the present Special Appeal stands disposed
of.
 (V.K. Bist, J.) (K.M. Joseph, C.J.)
 26.02.2015 26.02.2015
Rathour
